item.title: metacheck: 32 commits today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

Summary unavailable.

32 commit(s) today:

  • 439b297 [tro_provenance] reproducibility_check keeps what a TRACE Research Object (TRO) declaration needs (#404): start and end time and exit status of each script run, the SHA-256 hash, size and type of every file as downloaded, before the run and after it (artifacts), the hashes of the scripts metacheck changed, and the system that ran the code (environment: versions, Docker image and digest, network isolation, limits). Version 0.4.4.20 — Lakens
  • 8b65279 [fix_report_file_tabs] A report gives at most 20 files their own table in data_check's data previews and descriptives and in codebook_check's column documentation, so a deposit with many data files no longer gives a report pandoc cannot build within the server's time limit. Version 0.4.4.19 — Lakens
  • 8b1d22a [dev] Merge pull request #678 from scienceverse/fix_zip_cp437_names — Daniel Lakens
  • e3574dc [dev] Zips with names in the old DOS characters (CP437) are unpacked, and other text in an older encoding no longer stops a module. Version 0.4.4.18 — Lakens
  • f92f70f [dev] Merge pull request #677 from scienceverse/fix_675_archives — Daniel Lakens
  • 7b06105 [dev] download_repo_files() downloads OSF Storage and GitHub repositories linked to an OSF project as archives where that is worth it (#675). Version 0.4.4.17 — Lakens
  • 8e4cb6f [dev] Merge pull request #676 from scienceverse/fix_672_673 — Daniel Lakens
  • fbbc67a [dev] OSF links to a single file are found again (#672); data_check asks again for a batch whose model answer was cut off (#673). Version 0.4.4.16 — Lakens
  • 696a072 [dev] Merge pull request #674 from scienceverse/fix_psyarxiv_rds_xlsx — Daniel Lakens
  • 069d5d7 [dev] data_check reads .rds/.RData tables as plain data frames, and .xlsx files whose text cells hold no value without crashing R. Version 0.4.4.15 — Lakens
  • d490af4 [dev] Merge pull request #671 from scienceverse/link_improvement — Daniel Lakens
  • 49f2a80 [dev] Files inside a zip whose address has a space are downloaded too (#667): the address is encoded in .mc_request(), which nearly every request goes through, including the byte-range requests that fetch a zip's members, and in code_read() and .batch_query(). In metapsych.mp20234008 all 432 members of a GitHub zip still failed in 0.4.4.13. An address already encoded is left as it is. Version 0.4.4.14 — Lakens
  • 33b9965 [dev] repo_check keeps an R package in a subfolder when the repository holds no other data or code (#505): a package is left out as someone else's software only when real data or code is in the repository outside every package, wherever the package sits. Before, a package in a subfolder was always left out, so 10.1111/2041-210X.14387, whose own package sits in "good 2/", had no files. A README (also README.Rmd, which classifies as code) no longer counts as code in this decision. — Lakens
  • 4725175 [dev] Merge pull request #669 from scienceverse/fix_667_url_spaces — Daniel Lakens
  • 4f81dbc [dev] Merge dev into fix_667_url_spaces: keep the NEWS entries of both. Version 0.4.4.13 — Lakens
  • 0845b72 [dev] Merge pull request #665 from scienceverse/economics_journals — Daniel Lakens
  • ed7dabb [dev] Merge pull request #670 from scienceverse/ci_fewer_platforms — Daniel Lakens
  • 49d2659 [dev] Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/dev' into economics_journals — Lakens
  • e4b92ba [ci_fewer_platforms] R CMD check: a pull request into dev is checked on Linux and Windows with the released R only; all seven systems for a pull request into main, a weekly run, a run by hand and a push to cran_fixes or linux_docker_fixes. A push to dev is no longer checked again after its pull request was. — Lakens
  • 7c895ee [dev] Files in GitHub and GitLab repositories whose path holds a space are downloaded again, and files that could not be downloaded are shown in the report and counted (#667). Version 0.4.4.12 — Lakens
